_what: The agreement between the VESTA Kiosk and the VESTA Agent (the /agent/v1 interface), declared ONCE. The Kiosk's proxy (rootfs/usr/bin/supervisor-proxy.py) checks against it, the app (src/agent/agentApi.ts) reads its lists, and the VESTA Agent host keeps a copy (agent-host/contract/agent-contract.json) that its CI compares with this file. tests/agent-interface.py replays the samples through the real proxy; tests/oracles/agent_view.mjs parses the sample view. A change a version-1 agent cannot survive is a new version, not an edit to this one.
_ticketUpdate: One step in a Facility fault's history (FmTicketUpdate in src/fm/fmTypes.ts; the VESTA Agent writes them through /agent/v1/fm-data). `kind` says what the step is, so neither side reads a note's first words: none = a status step (raised, picked up, resolved; `by` the profile that recorded it, `who` the name typed for who does the work); reopened = a resolved fault open again (`by` who reopened it); retitled = the VESTA Agent changed the title (`title` the new one, `was` the one before); reading = what the VESTA Agent reads now on a fault whose title a person changed (`title`): the person's title stays; noted = a line of what happened about the fault on Telegram (a reminder or an escalation sent, a button pressed), `note` its words and `at` when — it changes neither the status nor the title, and a Kiosk lists it in /agent/v1/info `step_kinds` before the VESTA Agent writes one; cleared = resolved with no work done (the Kiosk's "Close — no action needed", the agent's own clearing of a problem gone) — never a repair in any figure. A step the VESTA Agent writes carries `title` when it gives the fault one, and `was` when it changes it. A completion the agent writes for a person's Done carries `who`, the person (its `by` is the agent's, stamped by the Kiosk).

ticketUpdate._clearedBefore: A close written before steps carried a kind is a close with no work when its note is one of `clearedNotes` or starts with one of `clearedNotePrefixes` (review 31).

_heartbeat: POST /agent/v1/heartbeat: the VESTA Agent says it is alive. `status`: a short text (at most 200 characters). `cadence` (optional): its own timing, which the Kiosk shows in the Overview's (i) instead of a copy of the defaults (architecture review, 2026-10-15) — `checkMinutes` how often it looks at its alerts and faults (1-1440), `nightlyAt` the villa time of its nightly check (HH:MM). Without it the Kiosk says no number.
_ticket: The Facility fault the VESTA Agent writes and reads (/agent/v1/fm-data), declared ONCE (architecture review, 2026-10-15: these were copies on each side, and a renamed stamp would have silently stopped the agent retitling its faults). `agentStamp`: the name the Kiosk's proxy stamps on every step and completion the agent writes, and `source` on every record it creates or changes — the agent tells its own steps from a person's by them. `origins`: where the agent made a fault from (its `origin` field: an alert, its nightly check, a chat's "Create this fault"), the Kiosk's source icon. `checks`: how the agent reads a fault again to close it (its `check` field) — "minutes" at every look (heartbeat.cadence.checkMinutes), "nightly" at its nightly check (heartbeat.cadence.nightlyAt) — the card's "Next check" (owner, 2026-10-15). `fields`: what the agent writes on a fault beyond the Kiosk's own. `takenStep`: a person took the fault on in the Kiosk ("Open Ticket") — a step with status in_progress, no kind, not stamped agentStamp: the agent stops chasing its alert. `sample`: one fault as the Kiosk holds it after the agent made it and a person took it on; both sides read it in their tests.

fields.alertNumber: integer: the alert's number as every chat writes it (#5); alerts only
fields.check: one of checks; absent on a fault only a person closes (chat)
